description:
Self-service dashboard endpoint. Revokes a session owned by the caller in the current workspace.
The session ends and its stored data is destroyed permanently; this is not sign-out.
Requires workspace **`enableSelfService: true`**.

Source: POST /api/v1/sessions/revoke/{sessionId}
Requires `auth.userToken` and forwards it as a Bearer token.
Prefer connection.workspaceName and connection.appId as stable config instead of generating identity fields dynamically.

appId.description: Optional secureFlows app id used as a default for hosted login tools

host.description: secureFlows base URL, for example https://api.example.com

workspaceName.description: Optional workspace name used as a default for tools that need it

name: post_sessions_revoke_session_id
title: Revoke a session owned by the current user
